The '''Bane Statue''' was an ancient [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] artifact that had the power to identify [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|practitioners]] by pivoting toward them.<ref name="Star Wars: Beware the Sith" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under his [[Force Clouding|public persona]] of Palpatine, possessed the Bane Statue. He kept it in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], among a vast collection of unusual art objects<ref name="TPMV" /> that he either picked up on his travels or received from fellow [[Politics/Legends|politicians]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|32|COR 11-12|Coruscant &ndash; Palpatine's Apartments}}</ref> Later on, Palpatine replaced the Republic by his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]], anointing himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Bane Statue had accompanied him to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] orbiting the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Along with other relics of Palpatine's senatorial suite, including a [[Unidentified Triffian carving|Triffian carving]] and a duo of fossilized [[trumpet weed]]s holding [[Ocean/Legends|marine]] pearls, the Bane Statue resided in a private suite of the hundred-story [[Emperor's Tower/Legends|Emperor's Tower]] which also housed the [[Emperor's Throne Room/Legends|throne room]].<ref name="SWCL" /> Ultimately, the Death Star was [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destroyed]] with everything it contained.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bane Statue was one of the art objects originally created for the apartment suite of Senator Palpatine in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] ([[May 19]], [[1999]]). Although it is not visible in the final version of the movie, the statue was shown in [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] ([[May 26]], 1999). Its name was first given in ''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]'' ([[February 20]], [[2012]]), where its nature and power were also revealed.
